description: Defines the enum class 'prach_format_type' for PRACH preamble formats, along with utility functions for string conversion, format classification, and duration calculation, based on 3GPP TS38.211 specifications.

classes.name: prach_format_type
classes.description: Enumeration of PRACH preamble formats as specified in 3GPP TS38.211.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts a 'prach_format_type' enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: to_prach_format_type
methods.description: Parses a string to return the corresponding 'prach_format_type' enum value.

methods.name: is_long_preamble
methods.description: Checks if the given preamble format is a long preamble.

methods.name: is_short_preamble
methods.description: Checks if the given preamble format is a short preamble.

methods.name: get_preamble_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in symbols of the preamble for the given format, based on TS38.211.
